Q.4 Multiple choice questions. 1x5=5
1. A 24-year-old woman has fatigue, malar rash and photosensitivity. ANA is positive. Which
antibody is most specific?
(a) Anti-Ro
(b) Anti-dsDNA
(c) Anti-centromere
(d) Anti-Jo-1
2. A 2-month-old infant receives a vaccine containing diphtheria, pertussis and tetanus
components. Which type of immunity does it induce?
(a) Passive natural
(b) Passive artificial
(c) Active artificial
(d) Active natural
3. A veterinarian has intermittent fever, sweating and arthralgia after handling infected cattle.
Which organism is most likely?
(a) Brucella melitensis
(b) Francisella tularensis
(c) Yersinia pestis
(d) Coxiella burnetiid
